destination_policy: fresh mode0700 run directory, exact checksum filename, retain failed partial bytes only as unverified quarantine
default_command_behavior: local hashes/signature/path checks only; no network or transfer
secrets_policy: fresh public authorization and transfer token/cookie in memory or child environment only; no persisted specs; no raw exception/client stdout/stderr/transfer logs
byte_limit_enforcement: OS RLIMIT_FSIZE=65536 in client; exact61787-byte regular-file check; no unexpected destination members accepted
time_limit_enforcement: Supervisor clock starts at main entry before local checks. Worker covers checks, metadata, one client invocation, verification and receipt writes with57-second allowance; parent always terminates worker process group and reaps<=1second. An outer59-second alarm kills that group and exits124 if any phase including final bounded readback stalls. Timeout or surviving descendants never accepted.
success_semantics: Only length checked and new localSHA256 recorded. No independent publisher digest for the checksum file itself is known. No image bytes decoded or acquired.
client_licensing: Official free developer SDK with its bundled runtime license; no software redistribution
negative_result: Initial public-relative versus resolved server source path comparison rejected before any transfer. Provider mapping is now pinned by SHA256 and exact checksum basename; changing mapping fails closed.
retry_policy: One direct ascp invocation; no application-level retry or resume (-k0). This does not claim absence of protocol packet retransmission or undocumented internal client reconnect behavior.
final_acceptance: Worker receipts require supervisor acceptance. A surviving group after reaped-successful worker is rejected. Otherwise supervisor rereads bounded receipt and payload after cleanup, comparing exact length and SHA256. Success requires accepted=true; exit124 or accepted=false leaves all bytes unaccepted.
